pageIntro: Papers, manuscripts, and theses on machine learning for clinical and other high-stakes data. A complete list is on Google Scholar.

entries.title: Two-Sided State-Space Models for Sequential Recommendation with Non-Random Multimodal Review Feedback
entries.authors: Ziwen Pan*, Zihan Liang*, Ruoxuan Xiong
bullets: TS-SSM jointly tracks evolving user preferences and item states, treating multimodal reviews and how they are expressed as non-random feedback, with cross-item spillovers and asymmetric persistence of positive and negative signals.
Across six Amazon datasets, it outperforms strong baselines, with 14.8%–18.8% relative gains in Recall@20 over BSARec, the primary sequential baseline.

entries.title: DART: Mitigating Harm Drift in Difference-Aware LLMs via Distill-Audit-Repair Training
entries.authors: Ziwen Pan*, Zihan Liang*, Jad Kabbara, Ali Emami
bullets: Identified harm drift in safety-tuned LLMs, where fine-tuning raises decision accuracy but makes rationales more harmful, and introduced DART, a Distill-Audit-Repair pipeline that improves difference-aware classification while keeping explanations safe.
On eight benchmarks, DART raised Llama-3-8B-Instruct accuracy from 39.0% to 68.8% and equal-treatment accuracy from 11.3% to 72.6%, while cutting harm drift cases by 72.6%.

entries.title: Learning Dynamic Representations and Policies from Multimodal Clinical Time-Series with Informative Missingness
entries.authors: Zihan Liang*, Ziwen Pan*, Ruoxuan Xiong
bullets: An MNAR-aware multimodal framework for clinical time series that treats observation patterns as signal, combining explicit missingness features, adaptive fusion of sparse clinical text, and action-conditioned latent dynamics to learn patient states for prediction and offline decision-making.

Evaluated on MIMIC-IV and eICU: mortality prediction reached AUROC 0.876 on MIMIC-IV (+3.9% over GRU-D), and the learned treatment policy improved FQE by 20.3% over clinician behavior, with the largest gains for high-severity patients.

entries.title: MambaDATG: Domain-Adaptive Tri-Plane-Gated Pre-training for 3D Abdominal Segmentation
entries.authors: Yaomin Shen*, Dongming Jiang*, Zihan Liang*, Yangbo Wei*, Wenkai Yang, Xiaoxin Sun, Zhen Huang, Suhua Wang, Qingsong Yao
bullets: A tri-plane-gated selective SSM pre-training that fuses axial, coronal, and sagittal views through voxel gating, capturing directional anisotropy with linear-time cost and no inference overhead.
A domain-adaptive masked image modeling stage on unlabeled CTs improves small-organ segmentation (e.g., +1.8 Dice on BTCV), with the tri-plane gate identified as the key performance driver.

entries.title: Dynamic Policy Design for Autonomous Taxi Adoption: A Hierarchical Game-Theoretic Framework
bullets: A three-tier dynamic Stackelberg game among government, platform, and workers, yielding equilibrium policies that balance innovation incentives with social welfare in autonomous taxi adoption.
An extended version is under review at Transportation Research Record.

entries.title: Causal Representation Learning from Multimodal Clinical Records under Non-Random Modality Missingness
entries.authors: Zihan Liang*, Ziwen Pan*, Ruoxuan Xiong
bullets: CRL-MMNAR treats non-random modality missingness as signal, combining missingness-aware fusion with cross-modal reconstruction and contrastive learning, plus a multitask predictor with a cross-fitted rectifier that corrects observation-pattern bias.

On MIMIC-IV, AUC rose from 0.8687 to 0.9824 for ICU admission (+13.1%) and from 0.7989 to 0.8657 for readmission (+8.4%); on eICU, readmission AUC reached 0.9294 (+13.8%), with lower Brier scores indicating better calibration.

entries.title: CareLab at #SMM4H-HeaRD 2025: Insomnia Detection and Food Safety Event Extraction with Domain-Aware Transformers
entries.authors: Zihan Liang*, Ziwen Pan*, Sumon Kanti Dey, Azra Ismail
bullets: Ranked 1st on SMM4H-HeaRD 2025 Task 5 with a RoBERTa system augmented by GPT-4, class-weighted training, and ensembling, reaching F1 = 0.958.
Error analysis revealed the limits of rule-based span extraction in clinical and food-safety text.

entries.title: Adaptive Spatiotemporal Graph Neural Networks with Trend-Aware Prediction and Validation-Gated Calibration for Traffic Flow Forecasting
entries.authors: Zihan Liang*, Ziwen Pan*, Shuyang Yu
entries.status: Under Review at IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
bullets: An adaptive spatiotemporal GNN that fuses distance- and correlation-based graphs with dual temporal–spatial encoders and a trend-aware head, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy on PeMS benchmarks.

A validation-gated calibration step, with hour-conditional quantile mapping and AR(1) residual correction, is applied only when it improves MAPE/MAE, keeping post-processing reliable and interpretable.

entries.title: Causal Representation Learning under Informative Missingness for Clinical Multimodal Prediction and Offline Decision-Making
entries.status: Emory College of Arts and Sciences Honors Thesis (Highest Honors)
bullets: A unified causal representation learning framework that models informative missingness at two scales, patient-level modality assignment and step-level monitoring intensity, as explicit variables for prediction and decision-making under MNAR clinical data.

Combines missingness-aware fusion, cross-modal self-supervision, and a cross-fitted rectifier for robust prediction under severe missingness and distribution shift, with MNAR-aware latent dynamics that support offline policy optimization (IQL) beyond clinician policies and strong RL baselines.

titleParts.text: Collective Action & Research for Equity (CARE) Lab

bullets: Maintain a WhatsApp education bot (Python, Twilio) for MakerGhat, an India-based organization, that helps 15,000+ teachers document lesson plans and teaching activities, reaching 600,000+ students and 10,000+ educational projects.

Analyzed nearly 1,000 user data points in an interactive dashboard (JavaScript, Python, HTML) and built an offline-first Android app for classroom session recording with Google Sheets validation, offline caching, and secure Drive sync.
Developed and analyzed ordinary differential equation models of the community transmission of Clostridioides difficile (C. difficile), implementing simulations in MATLAB and R.
Worked with the team to evaluate mitigation strategies and identify optimal interventions for controlling community spread.
